operators.name: abs_forward
semantics: Computes element-wise absolute value of input tensor x.
Matches torch.abs semantics: output[i] = |x[i]| for all elements.
Preserves shape, stride, contiguous layout and dtype of input.
No reduction or broadcast; pure elementwise operation.

operators.name: log_softmax_forward
semantics: Computes log softmax over the entire input tensor, matching nn.LogSoftmax()(x) with default dim=None equivalent to flattening all elements.
For input of size N, output_i = x_i - log(sum_j exp(x_j)) where sum is over all elements of tensor.
Numerically stable implementation must subtract max element before exp and log-sum-exp.
Preserves shape, stride, dtype and device of input.
Element-wise absolute value of tensor x; output shape equals input shape.
Log softmax over entire tensor; output shape equals input shape; uses max subtraction for numerical stability.
Return the log softmax output tensor.
